title: HS30094: Economics Of Rural Development
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse ContentsEconomics and Rural Studies, Nature and Scope
Rural Development; Rural Development-Approaches, Experiments, Policies and
Programmes; Rural Infrastructure and Rural Development; Agricultural
Transformation and Rural Development; Rural Banking and Credit; Rural
Industrialization; Decentralization and Rural Development; Rural Marketing;
Globalization and Rural Development-The Role of Institutions; Micro Finance and
Rural Development; Womens Participation and Rural Development; Rural Poverty:
Concept and Measurement; Entitlement and Deprivation; Rural-Urban
Interdependence - Models of Rural-Urban Migration, Migration and Urbanization
Dilemma; Urban Bias; Explaining Growth in a Rural-Urban System; Rural
Development in India; Rural Policies; NGOs and Rural Development.
